svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Data lake on AWS
svg.desc: Data lake on AWS. 15 components in 7 groups. Connections: Web and mobile apps to Amazon Data Firehose; Amazon Data Firehose to Raw bucket; Orders database to AWS DMS; AWS DMS to Raw bucket; Raw bucket to Clean and convert; Clean and convert to Curated bucket; Curated bucket to Aggregate; Aggregate to Analytics bucket; Analytics bucket to Amazon Athena; Analytics bucket to Amazon Redshift; Amazon Athena to Amazon QuickSight; Amazon Redshift to Amazon QuickSight; Glue crawlers to Glue Data Catalog; AWS Lake Formation to Glue Data Catalog; Glue Data Catalog to Amazon Athena.

text.tspan: Streaming and database sources land in S3; Glue refines them zone by zone for Athena, Redshift and QuickSight
